info.description: This is the API access for the backend of the FreezeTag app.
info.title: FreezeTag API

get.description: Lists visible albums with id, name, owner and explicit shared users (owner only).

post.description: Create a new album with a given name and visibility mode

get.description: List albums associated with an image, including id, name and owner of each album.
Get album information for a specific album ID.

delete.description: Delete an album by ID. User must be an owner of the album.

get.description: Lists image IDs in an album visible to the requesting user.

post.description: Add an image to an album
post.summary: Add image to album, user must have write access to the album

delete.description: Remove an image from an album
delete.summary: Remove image from album, user must have write access to the album

patch.description: Rename an album. User must be an owner of the album.

get.description: Get explicit per-user permissions for an album.

put.description: Set the permission level of a user for a specific album

patch.description: Set the visibility mode of an album

delete.description: Delete an image file given an ID

get.description: Get an image file given an ID

post.description: Cancel a job given a job ID

get.description: Retrieves the current details of a job batch, including specifics of individual in-progress/completed/failed jobs
Lists all job batches, including currently running, scheduled, and cancelled/finished (before deletion)
Retrieves a summary of a job batch, with a high-level overview of progress
Checks if the user is currently authenticated.

post.description: Authenticates a user using form parameters "username" and "password". On success returns a JSON payload containing an authentication token.
post.summary: Authenticate user and return a token
invalidate the current user's session token

get.description: Retrieve metadata for an image

post.description: Allows an authenticated user to change their password by providing their current password and a new password.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all available permissions in the system.
Get the configuration fields of a plugin

post.description: Change a map of plugin config values
Set the enabled status of a plugin by name (plugin names are unique)

parameters.description: whether the plugin should be enabled
parameters.name: enabled

get.description: List plugins along with their hooks and enabled status

post.description: Start running a manual plugin hook by name

202.description: the UUID of the created job for the plugin run

post.description: Add a new plugin by submitting a Git link

get.description: Search for an image given information

post.description: Add tags to images (or to the database if no images are specified)

get.description: Get all tags and the total count of the overlap for each tag associated with the provided image IDs

parameters.description: image IDs to get tag counts for
parameters.name: id

get.description: Get all the tags in the database
Get all the tags associated with an image

parameters.description: image ID to get the tags of
parameters.name: id

get.description: Get all tags and the total overlap count for a search query
Get a WEBP format image thumbnail for an image

delete.description: Permanently delete an API token from the database. This action cannot be undone. Admins can delete any token.

parameters.description: ID of the token to delete
parameters.name: id

post.description: Revoke an API token, preventing it from being used for authentication. This is a softer action than deleting a token. Admins can revoke any token.

parameters.description: ID of the token to revoke
parameters.name: id

post.description: Create a new API token for the authenticated user with the specified permissions and expiration time

parameters.description: Optional expiration time for the token in RFC3339 format (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)
parameters.name: expiresAt

parameters.description: List of permissions to assign to the token
parameters.name: permission

post.description: Revoke an API token, preventing it from being used for authentication. Users can only revoke their own tokens

parameters.description: ID of the token to revoke
parameters.name: id

post.description: Upload a set of image files to the server

202.description: the UUID of the created job batch for the upload

get.description: Retrieves a list of all users in the system.
get.summary: List the users in the system

post.description: Creates a new user with the provided username and password, granted they have permission to create users.

get.description: Lists the permissions of a user by their ID.

post.description: Grants specified permissions for a user by their ID.

delete.description: Revokes specified permissions for a user by their ID.

parameters.description: Permissions to revoke in the form read/write/delete:name
parameters.name: permission

get.description:
Retrieves the profile picture of a user by their ID.
Retrieves the profile picture of a user by their ID.

post.description: Updates the profile picture of a user by their ID. Accepts a multipart form with a "picture" file field. a user can only update their own profile picture,

delete.description: Resets the profile picture of a user to the default generated avatar. A user can only reset their own profile picture,
delete.summary: Reset a user's profile picture to default

post.description: Sets the visibility mode of a user by their ID. The visibility mode determines who can see the user's profile and images. Accepts a query parameter "mode" with values 0, 1, or 2, where 0 means only the user can see their profile and images, 1 means anyone can see their profile but only followers can see their images, and 2 means anyone can see their profile and images. a user can only update their own visibility mode, but an admin with the appropriate permissions can update any user's visibility mode.

get.description: Retrieves a user's public information by their ID.
get.summary: Get a public user by ID

delete.description: Deletes a user from the system by their ID.
